rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaai!
rows.notes: Repeated salute in three original uses; retain elongated cry.
uncertain: Exact established English catchcry spelling unconfirmed.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaai!
rows.notes: Same allegiance salute as Hidler.
uncertain: Exact established English catchcry spelling unconfirmed.

rows.en: Elite warriors of the Hyakki Empire. We of the Hyakki clan alone are worthy to rule this Earth Sphere...
Yet it is teeming with those incompetent humans.
Rest assured, Emperor Burai! Once we bare our fangs, those humans will be nothing to fear.
You inspire confidence, General Hidler...
Then turn every last human into one of the Hyakki clan... and claim this world for me.
Now, Dr. Gura... give me an outline of the plan for world conquest you have devised.
Yes, Your Majesty. The Earth Sphere, already troubled by conflicts among humans...
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row9; source boundary retained. Meaning/grammar correction: connects the human conflicts to the Earth Sphere before the sentence continues in row9.

rows.en: ...has been thrown into chaos by invaders from space and the appearance of unknown beings.
rows.notes: Completes row8 sentence.

rows.en: We will exploit that opening and launch our invasion all at once... but there is one problem.
What is it?
It is the energy we use on this Hyakki Fortress Island.
uncertain: Hyakki Fortress Island exact English provenance unverified in existing glossary.

rows.en: What do you mean? The fortress island is operating without any problems.
True... if things remain as they are. However, we must conquer the world in a short span of time.
Hmm... Mighty as my fortress island is, we will be at a disadvantage if the enemy brings superior numbers and resources to bear.
rows.notes: Meaning correction: material warfare includes resources as well as sheer numbers.

rows.en: Yes. That is why we must prepare an overwhelming fighting force.
And... producing vast numbers of Hyakki Robots and Hyakki soldiers will require an enormous amount of energy.
rows.notes: Generic Hyakki robot class follows campaign_terms.json and the existing Hyakki stem; not the named Combined Hyakki Robot unit.
uncertain: Independent canonical English wording for the standalone Hyakki robot class remains unestablished.

rows.en: Then how will we obtain that energy?
We shall obtain the Getter Ray amplifier developed at the Saotome Institute.
rows.notes: Ignore stray closing wrapper and trailing break per brief. Getter Ray amplifier follows newly sourced campaign_terms.json: SRW Wiki equates amplification reactor/device, and Akurasu uses Getter Ray amplifier. Coordinator name correction retained after meaning review; initial draft preserved.

rows.en: Then, once we improve and mass-produce it, installing those reactors on this fortress island should solve our energy problem in one stroke.
Very well... General Hidler, send Hyakki Robots to the Saotome Institute immediately.
rows.notes: Generic Hyakki robot class follows campaign_terms.json and the existing Hyakki stem; not the named Combined Hyakki Robot unit.
uncertain: Independent canonical English wording for the standalone Hyakki robot class remains unestablished.

rows.en: And raise the Hyakki Empire's signal of war for all the world to see.
You wish to offer me your opinion... What is it, Saiga?
rows.notes: Scene changes from Hyakki command to Yuratei and Saiga.

rows.en: It concerns measures against those besides Zeorymer of the Heavens who might stand in the way of our Tekkoryu.
rows.notes: Tekkoryu organization; no explanatory alias appended.

rows.en: Besides Zeorymer, you say...? Who are these people?
I believe Your Majesty has already heard of them...
rows.notes: Polite lead-in trails into row27.

rows.en: They are the Nahel Argama unit that appeared after the battle between Zeorymer and Lanstar.
I believe I heard they are a unit assembled from super robots... Could they become an obstacle to us?
They are not yet... but eventually they will be.
rows.notes: Explicit future threat inferred from Yuratei question; subject and verb restored.

rows.en: Besides... Zeorymer may be incorporated into that unit, just as the other super robots were.
To fulfill Your Majesty's long-cherished wish, I believe we should nip them in the bud before they can grow.
rows.notes: Saiga recommends eliminating unit to achieve Yuratei ambition.

rows.en: Very well. I shall send Fire and Water against them at once.
rows.notes: Fire and Water refer to Shi sisters and their elemental robots; keep labels.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, just as I wanted...
rows.notes: Actual thought; private scheming laugh.

rows.en: I had best reduce the ranks of my potential enemies early... even if they are fellow Hakkeshu.
rows.notes: Actual thought; Hakkeshu identifies Saiga fellow elite pilots as rivals.
uncertain: Source abbreviated Hakke interpreted as Hakkeshu elite pilots from Fire/Water and personal-rival context.

rows.notes: Silence checked at all five original uses.

rows.en: What you see in this footage is you, Masato Akitsu...
rows.notes: New scene: Oki shows Masato footage of laboratory cultivation.

rows.en: That's me...? That's me inside the test tube...!?
rows.notes: Masato recoils at image of himself inside test tube. Meaning correction: repeated demonstrative expresses shocked self-recognition; do not add dehumanizing disdain with thing.

rows.en: That is correct.
What do you mean...!? Are you saying... I was a test-tube baby!?
rows.notes: Masato addresses Oki about his image in a test tube; preserves incredulous double question.

rows.en: You were grown in pure culture for a certain purpose... You are the only specimen of your kind on Earth.
rows.notes: Oki explains deliberate pure-culture creation and unique individual status on Earth.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: Yes... You were made to pilot Zeorymer.
rows.notes: Miku confirms Oki and explicitly restores Masato as the person created for piloting.

rows.en: N-no...! Th-that's a lie...
rows.notes: Retains both stutters and denial.

rows.en: It's reality. Accept it.
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: So... so that's why you're telling me to fight Hau Dragon in Zeorymer!?
rows.notes: Masato asks whether Oki is commanding him to fight; request direction is Oki to Masato.

rows.en: Yes. That is your destiny.
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: I'm... a human created to pilot Zeorymer...
rows.notes: Actual thought; restores first-person copula while preserving trailing realization.

rows.en: And Miku Himuro was, too...
rows.notes: Actual thought; completes the context-settled parallel claim about Miku while retaining the trailing ellipsis.

rows.en: But even a test-tube baby... must have people who supplied the sperm and egg.
rows.notes: Actual thought; sperm and egg donor detail retained.

rows.en: And if we had the same donors... does that mean Miku and I are brother and sister...?
rows.notes: Actual thought; shared donors refers to Masato and Miku having the same origins, not one person supplying both gametes.

rows.en: Masato.
rows.notes: Vocative only, as in source.

rows.en: Oki told you about Tekkoryu... Hau Dragon, didn't he?
rows.notes: Source speaks both Tekkoryu and its Hau Dragon reading/name; both retained.

rows.en: He did. An army of robots plotting to rule the world, right? Fine by me. It's nothing to do with me.
rows.notes: Masato dismisses Hau Dragon as irrelevant to him; army, robots and world-rule plot retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh...
rows.notes: Quiet laugh, contrasting with Masato anxiety.

rows.en: What's so funny?
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: You'll fight them in Zeorymer. That is your fate.
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: Why!? How can you be so calm about this!?
rows.notes: Masato challenges Miku calmness; this is not a question about his own composure.
Intentional silence.

rows.en: How can you accept being a human created solely to pilot that robot...!?
rows.notes: Masato challenges Miku acceptance of being made solely to pilot; context-settled second person.

rows.en: Being human means... well, you know... all sorts of things...!
rows.notes: Deliberately stumbling unfinished explanation; no clear further predicate exists in source.

rows.en: Does it? Don't all humans live with some destiny laid out for them from the start?
rows.notes: Miku questions Masato objection, then proposes inborn destiny for everyone.
Same exclamation serves i025b:66 after destiny question and i025b:73 after two Hakke robots report.

rows.en: And for us, that destiny was Zeorymer... That's what I think, Masato.
rows.notes: Miku includes both herself and Masato; explicit personal belief ending retained.

rows.en: Oki, what's happened!?
rows.notes: Natural complete response; no source omission retained.

rows.en: The Saotome Institute on Mount Asama is under attack by a mysterious force of mobile weapons...
rows.notes: Oki reports ongoing attack; Mount Asama and generic mobile weapons retained. Mount Asama confirmed by centralized campaign_terms entry (Akurasu Getter Robo; official JNTO).

rows.en: And... we've had a report that two Hakke robots are heading there.
rows.notes: Oki reports two Hakke robots en route to the institute.

rows.en: The Hakke robots are heading to Saotome Institute instead of here...!?
rows.notes: Miku contrasts the institute with their current location; restores heading verb.

rows.en: We don't know why. Federation troops are fighting back, but it's only a matter of time before they're overrun...
rows.notes: Overrun refers to the defending Federation troops; uncertainty concerns enemy motive.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama unit is heading toward Mount Asama to help, but we'll deploy Zeorymer as well.
rows.notes: Both Nahel Argama relief movement and Oki decision to deploy Zeorymer retained. Mount Asama confirmed by centralized campaign_terms entry (Akurasu Getter Robo; official JNTO).

rows.en: Is that all right? Making contact with that unit...
rows.notes: Miku asks permission with concern about contact; second clause deliberately trails off.

rows.en: If we're facing Hakke robots, that's a different matter. Launch at once.
rows.notes: Oki orders Miku and Masato to launch; opposing Hakke robots overrides contact concern.

rows.en: Understood. ...We're going, Masato.
rows.notes: Miku acknowledges Oki, then addresses Masato.

rows.en: Do I... have no choice but to pilot that thing...!?
rows.notes: Actual thought; Masato doubts whether he has any alternative to piloting.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: [jp] = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; [jp] -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: [jp] object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: [jp] has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: [jp]: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary [jp] = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; [jp] speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term [jp], do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit ([jp] = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: [jp] kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: [jp] has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: [jp] / [jp]: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: [jp] ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: [jp] rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: [jp]: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: [jp] = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: [jp] = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: [jp]: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: [jp]… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full [jp] remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. An enemy unit reaches Saotome Institute@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat-condition list; exactly one @ retained and no speaker added.

rows.en: Those aren't Mechasauruses...! Who on earth are they!?
rows.notes: Saotome recognizes the attackers are not Dinosaur Empire machines, before Hidler identifies himself. Generic Mechasaurus and plural Mechasauruses confirmed by centralized campaign_terms entry (Akurasu Getter Robo episode2 / Mech List).

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I am General Hidler of the Hyakki Empire.
rows.notes: Hidler introduces himself to Saotome; source rank maps to locked General Hidler.

rows.en: The Hyakki Empire...!?
rows.notes: Saotome repeats unfamiliar organization name in surprise; deliberate echo fragment.

rows.en: Indeed. Under Emperor Burai, ours is the empire of the Hyakki clan that will rule the entire world in place of you foolish humans.
rows.notes: Hidler addresses Dr. Saotome; racial supremacy and replacing human rule preserved.

rows.en: You mean to rule the entire world...!
rows.notes: Saotome responds in alarm; subject restored.

rows.en: The Hyakki are the finest clan in this world... So it is only natural that the entire world should be ruled by us!
rows.notes: Hidler asserts supremacy as justification for world rule.

rows.en: And we shall turn every last one of you humans into demons!
rows.notes: Hidler promises forced transformation of every human, with no exception.

rows.en: You intend not only to rule the world, but to remake us humans as well...!?
rows.notes: Saotome explicitly includes humanity and forced remaking.

rows.en: As the first step in our plan for world conquest, we shall seize your Getter Ray amplifier!
rows.notes: Amplifier term follows campaign_terms; first step of world-conquest plan retained.
Source shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: Now, go! Hyakki robots!!
rows.notes: Orders addressed to generic Hyakki robots; plural follows the enemy group.

rows.en: Stop right there! I won't let you lay a finger on the institute!
rows.notes: Ryoma addresses attackers and promises to defend the institute.

rows.en: What!? Who are they!?
rows.notes: Hidler notices arriving allies; interrogative restored.

rows.en: The Getter Team... And the Nahel Argama squad! You've made it in time!
rows.notes: Saotome recognizes both arriving forces; Getter Team and Nahel Argama squad retained.

rows.en: Father, are you all right!?
rows.notes: Michiru checks her father, Dr. Saotome.

rows.en: Don't worry about me. More importantly, their aim is to seize the institute's Getter Ray amplifier!
rows.notes: Saotome redirects Michiru from his safety to enemy objective.

rows.en: They want the amplifier...!?
rows.notes: Ryoma echoes the seizure objective; subject and verb restored.

rows.en: They're the exact opposite of the Dinosaur Empire.
rows.notes: Hayato contrasts seizure with Dinosaur Empire destruction.

rows.en: Yeah... They feared Getter Rays and aimed to destroy the facilities and equipment connected with them.
rows.notes: They refers to the Dinosaur Empire, not the current attackers; both facilities and equipment retained.

rows.en: So this lot wants to use Getter Rays to conquer the world, huh?
rows.notes: Hayato infers the current enemies intend conquest using Getter Rays.

rows.en: Precisely! We of the Hyakki clan are the ones fit to rule this world!
rows.notes: Hidler confirms Hayato and asserts Hyakki entitlement.

rows.en: In a way, they're pretty easy to understand.
rows.notes: Asuka dryly calls their motives easy to understand; qualification retained.

rows.en: Exactly. They aren't spouting complicated slogans about humanity's evolution or a better world order.
rows.notes: Light answers Asuka; ideological slogans are examples, not claims about Hyakki aims. Stray Japanese closing wrapper ignored.

rows.en: Hyakki, hiccups, whatever you are, I won't let you have your way!
rows.notes: Benkei deliberately confuses Hyakki with hiccups; exact joke objects retained. Sound play is imperfect in English.
uncertain: Japanese Hyakki/hiccups sound play cannot be reproduced directly; preserved deliberate misnaming.

rows.en: If you stand in our way, we will show no mercy, whoever you are! Hyakki robots, begin your attack!
rows.notes: Hidler threatens anyone opposing him, then commands robots.

rows.en: Ryo, don't let them get anywhere near the institute!
rows.notes: Hayato tells Ryoma to exclude enemies from institute; nickname Ryo preserved.

rows.en: Yeah, I know!
rows.notes: Ryoma confirms he understands Hayato.

rows.en: All units, launch at once! Defend the Saotome Institute!
rows.notes: Bright commands all units; shortened institute source expands to fixed Saotome Institute.

rows.en: Grrr! They have this much power...!
rows.notes: Repeated defeat-event uses checked; surprise at allied strength and trailing amazement retained.

rows.en: Grr! If only we could use Twin Lord...!!
rows.notes: Repeated defeat-event uses checked; unrealized conditional deliberately trails off. We refers to twin pilots.

rows.en: Damn it, remember this! I'll make you regret defying the Hyakki Empire!!
rows.notes: Hidler retreat threat; warning and regret preserved.

rows.en: We will defeat you and make this world the property of the Hyakki clan!
rows.notes: Hidler combat boast to Getter Team; explicit we and clan ownership retained.

rows.en: What the hell are you talking about!? We'll smash your ambitions to pieces!
rows.notes: Benkei rebuts Hidler roughly; smash their ambitions retained.

rows.en: Yeah...! Those lizards are waiting for you in hell.
rows.notes: Hayato refers to fallen Dinosaur Empire enemies as lizards; hell threat retained.

rows.en: Hmph! Do not lump us together with those reptilian humans!
rows.notes: Hidler rejects comparison to the Dinosaur Empire species; source creature label rendered literally as reptilian humans.
uncertain: Literal reptilian humans for the Dinosaur Empire species label; exact fixed English glossary entry requested from root.

rows.en: We have no choice... I'm going in!
rows.notes: Shi-Aen initiates attack on Zeorymer; no-choice rationale retained.

rows.en: W-why are you attacking me...!!
rows.notes: Masato addresses attackers; attacking restored from event context but distressed interruption retained.

rows.en: Zeorymer...! With my own hands alone, I will...!!
rows.notes: Shi-Tau targets Zeorymer and insists on personal action; deliberate unfinished threat retained with subject and verb.

rows.en: I-it's coming!
rows.notes: Masato warns of the incoming attack after Shi-Tau threatens Zeorymer. Neutral it avoids unsupported plural or gender referent.

rows.en: Calm down... Keep your head and deal with them!
rows.notes: Miku steadies Masato and tells him to respond calmly.

rows.en: Hyakki Empire! If you threaten the peace, we'll take you on!
rows.notes: Duke directly challenges Hyakki Empire over threats to peace.

rows.en: Impudent fools! The thought of mere humans challenging us is laughable!
rows.notes: Hidler contemptuously dismisses humans daring to fight Hyakki.

rows.en: You demons are a bunch of dirty cowards, attacking the Saotome Institute while Ryo and the rest of us were away!
Silence, humans! Even if you all band together, you amount to nothing!
Raideen of Mutropolis, is it? In time, we shall claim the power of Mutron as well!
Are these guys trying to steal super energy!?
rows.notes: Explicitly preserves energy theft rather than merely being after energy; no unsupported our.

rows.en: Argh! Stop darting around, you annoying little pest!!
Heh! Over here, demon! Come toward the sound of my clapping!!
rows.notes: Preserves the demon-tag clapping taunt.

rows.en: Demons or whatever you are, all you crooks pull the same old tricks!
Silence, boy! I won't let the likes of you thwart the Hyakki clan's first step toward world conquest!
I thought demons only existed in fairy tales, but...
rows.notes: Retains deliberate trailing but...

rows.en: Come on, you demon bastard! We'll pelt you with beans!!
rows.notes: Preserves bean-throwing demon joke.

rows.en: Boy! You dare mock the Hyakki clan!?
The enemy's a demon... A demon... The enemy isn't human...!
rows.notes: Shinji reassures himself; subject restored in final nonhuman statement. Source kind remains dialogue.

rows.en: What are you mumbling about!? Don't lump the Hyakki clan in with you stupid, spineless humans!
The enemy isn't human...! So... so I don't need to hesitate...!
rows.notes: Restores I as the one who need not hesitate.

rows.en: You've come, fool! I'll crush you beneath this Yousaiki!
rows.notes: Source-short Yousaiki from glossary Mecha Yousaiki; no added Mecha. Source-short Yousaiki confirmed by main Akurasu mapping and Hidler mothership context; central alias recorded.

rows.en: Be careful, #男愛称! That's the enemy's mothership!
We're fighting demons! I'll blast them with my peashooter!
rows.notes: Peashooter retains bean-gun/pigeon joke continued at134.

rows.en: Hold on! Beans are one thing, but you aim a peashooter at pigeons, not demons!
rows.notes: Pigeon contrast preserved rather than explaining idiom.

rows.en: ...Don't sweat the details!!
Have you joined forces with the Hyakki Empire!?
What nonsense... Tekkoryu shall rule the world... We have no need of allies!
rows.notes: Tekkoryu uses glossary organization root without parenthetical gloss.

rows.en: Tau, remember to coordinate with me! It's dangerous to underestimate this opponent!
rows.notes: Aen asks Tau to coordinate with her; opponent is Ryoma.

rows.en: Grr... I know that without you telling me!!
You fool! You're stupid enough to attack me!?
Calm down, Tau! We can only show our true strength by working together!
I don't need orders, Sister! I can handle an opponent like this all by myself!
rows.notes: Sister preserves elder-sister address.

rows.en: What... The pilots of those red and blue machines are sisters...!?
That has nothing to do with this battle!
Yes, it does! Sisters are strong because they help each other! Just like me and Ple Two!
Don't slip up, Hokuto! Those red and blue robots... I bet they're planning something!
I know, Ginga! Just make sure you don't charge in too far yourself!
This machine... It has two pilots... And the two are perfectly in sync...
rows.notes: Thought: Aen observes Ginga and Hokuto coordinating in their two-seat machine.

rows.en: You think you're so clever...! Sister, let me take on this blue robot!
rows.notes: Tau contemptuously dismisses the two pilots' coordination and asks her elder sister to let her fight the blue robot.

rows.en: Tau... We're sisters with the same face, so why are our hearts so far apart...?
rows.notes: Thought contrasts identical faces and emotional estrangement.

rows.en: I'm going in! #女愛称, keep the power output steady!
rows.notes: Hugo orders Aqua to stabilize output; runtime labels retained.

rows.en: I'm already doing that! You don't have to tell me!
Woman... It seems you're nothing more than that man's assistant.
rows.notes: Tau belittles Aqua as support to Hugo.
Wordless shock at the threat of death; retained punctuation-only source.

rows.en: Lament your fate: serving someone else until the end, without a chance to show your own strength.
rows.notes: Tau attacks Aqua's role; no added gender inference.

rows.en: Tau!
rows.notes: Both uses are Aen admonishing Tau, including event11 after source owner180.

rows.en: #女愛称! Don't fall for the enemy's sweet talk! In a real battle...
rows.notes: Hugo interrupts his combat advice when Aqua insists she already understands; keep the trailing clause.

rows.en: I know without you telling me every little thing! And I do take pride in my own role, you know!
Yeah! That's the spirit, #女愛称!
What!? Who are they!?
rows.notes: Ryoma sees newly arriving Hakke robots; retain surprise and identification question.

rows.en: Could those be Hakke robots...!?
Hmph. So someone besides us is after the Saotome Institute?
So that's the Nahel Argama squad...
It seems some unfamiliar visitors got here before us. Tau, they're...
rows.notes: Shi-Aen starts explaining the unfamiliar Hyakki visitors to Tau and is interrupted.

rows.en: I know without you telling me every little thing, Sister.
Our target is the Nahel Argama squad. Don't engage those others... That's what you mean, isn't it?
rows.notes: Tau preempts Aen: their target is the allied squad, not the Hyakki force.

rows.en: ...Yes, that's right.
Then we, the Shi sisters of the Hakkeshu, masters of Water and Fire...
rows.notes: Self-introduction continues into Aen's challenge in168; preserve unfinished sentence.

rows.en: Here we come!
Ignore them! Occupy the institute as quickly as possible!
Sister! These readings...!
rows.notes: Recognition fragment introducing the Zeorymer readings.

rows.en: Could it be that thing!?
Zeorymer...!
That's Dr. Kihara's...!
rows.notes: Misato recognizes Zeorymer as Dr. Kihara's machine; deliberately unfinished possessive.

rows.en: Damn you, Zeorymer. You detected our signatures and came out?
Perfect. If we reclaim it with our own hands right here, the Empress will be pleased.
rows.notes: The Empress is Yuratei, whose glossary explicitly records female gender.

rows.en: Wait, Tau. Yuratei's orders are strictly to annihilate the Nahel Argama squad...
We shouldn't engage Zeorymer right now.
What are you saying, Sister? Taking the Heavens is the Empress's true wish. If we retreat here, we'll disgrace the Hakkeshu name!
rows.notes: Heavens is the short elemental designation of Zeorymer, not a literal place.

rows.en: Stop acting on your own! Have you forgotten about working together!?
That means nothing while we still can't use Twin Lord!
rows.notes: That refers to coordinated fighting in179; Twin Lord spelling from glossary.

rows.en: They call Fire and Water a pair of Hakke robots...! They say they share the same fate as us sisters...!
rows.notes: Indignant quoted comparison: paired Fire/Water robots parallel the two sisters. Preserve repeated hearsay fragments; source wording does not specify the person making the comparison.
uncertain: Source comparison is deliberately fragmentary; paired Fire/Water and the sisters' shared fate are retained as indignant hearsay.

rows.en: My Gallowin of the Waters alone is more than enough to take that thing on!
Masato, are you ready? We're going to stop the Hakke robots.
rows.notes: Miku asks Masato to prepare for the fight; no direction reversal.

rows.en: ...This is... Are you saying this is my fate...?
rows.notes: Masato echoes the pre-battle revelation that piloting Zeorymer is his fate; thought.

rows.en: Can you hear me? I'm switching to combat mode.
rows.notes: Miku announces her own combat-mode switch, addressing the silent Masato.

rows.en: Masato... If you have no intention of fighting, why did you get into Zeorymer?
I can't go back to where I used to be anymore. This is the only place I belong...
rows.notes: Masato answers why he boarded: nowhere else to belong after his origin revelation.

rows.en: That's right, isn't it, Miku?
...Concentrate on the battle for now. The Hakke robots are going to come after us.
...All right.
1. An enemy unit reaches Saotome Institute@2. Zeorymer is shot down@3. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions; preserve three plain segments and their original order.

rows.en: Damn...! If only I could have coordinated with Gallowin!
rows.notes: Separate defeat event; counterfactual regret about failed coordination, not a promise.

rows.en: Is this all I can do on my own...!? No, that can't be!!
rows.notes: Separate defeat event; Tau rejects that fighting alone has reached its limit.

rows.en: Grr! Should I withdraw for now and rethink our strategy...!?
rows.notes: Hidler's separate retreat event, phrased as his own deliberation.

rows.en: The enemy signals have disappeared.
What about Last Guardian's Zeorymer?
rows.notes: Bright asks the status of the same Zeorymer whose communications Torres reports cut in197; restored question predicate.

rows.en: They've cut off communications. I doubt there's any point in trying to contact them...
rows.notes: Zeorymer crew deliberately cut their link; plural they avoids assuming which pilot acted.

rows.en: Masato, we're heading back.
Yeah...
That robot's gone off again.
I wonder what sort of person is piloting it...?

rows.notes: Source silence retained; deliberate nonverbal fragment.

rows.en: Judging by the fact that no place besides this institute has come under attack...
rows.notes: Source inference clause deliberately continues into203.

rows.en: I believe it will be some time before the Hyakki Empire begins a full-scale invasion.
So... you're saying they're building up their forces right now?
Indeed.
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing bracket and trailing source @ as directed by brief.

rows.en: So they came after the Getter Ray amplifier to mass-produce those weapons they call Hyakki robots...
rows.notes: Source calls the enemy weapons those called Hyakki robots; retained this distancing and mass-production purpose.

rows.en: That's not all. They'll also seek Photon Power energy, Mutron, photonic energy, Daimolite, and...
rows.notes: Energy list and ellipsis continue into208; seek restores the source-settled shared verb.

rows.en: even the energy used by that mobile weapon belonging to Last Guardian.
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation of207, whose verb seek governs this object; no added Zeorymer name.

rows.en: So the Hyakki Empire's immediate goal is to acquire those super energies?
Yes.
Then the Nahel Argama unit might become their target.
rows.notes: Nahel Argama unit is the task force, not just its carrier. Ignored stray closing bracket/trailing source @.

rows.en: Yeah. Our unit's practically a trade show for special energy sources.
We'll ask the Earth Federation Army to reinforce our security here. You must all be very careful, too.
rows.notes: Source-backed organization name expanded to exact glossary Earth Federation Army after meaning review.

rows.en: Understood.
Well then, we'll be going...
Misato, could you head back ahead of us? We have something to take care of.
rows.notes: Ryoma asks Misato to return ahead while the Getter Team stays to visit Musashi; request direction retained.

rows.en: Yes, of course.
Musashi, another new enemy has appeared before us...
rows.notes: Addressed to deceased Musashi, whose identity/death is recorded in campaign_terms.

rows.en: But you can rest in peace.
rows.notes: Musashi is deceased; sleep rendered as peaceful rest, not physical sleep.

rows.en: We'll protect the peace of the Earth in your place, Musashi.
rows.notes: Address continues to Musashi. Decorative senpai dropped; promise and determination retained. Removed draft Count on us because it added a request absent from this promise.

rows.en: We... probably won't be able to come back to the institute for a while again, but...
rows.notes: Deliberate trailing concession to deceased Musashi; institute return is not a combat retreat.

rows.en: You're always in our hearts.
So please wait here with the doctor until we come home...
rows.notes: Doctor is Saotome. Ryoma asks Musashi to await their return, keeping memorial conceit.

rows.en: Getter Robo... So you have indeed become an obstacle to us.
I-I'm terribly sorry, Emperor Burai.
Very well. For now, let us be satisfied that we obtained valuable data.
Dr. Gura, begin mass production of Hyakki robots on Hyakki Fortress Island as it stands now.
rows.notes: Actual supplied speaker label Dr. Gura retained also in address, per source-backed fixed name.
uncertain: Hyakki Fortress Island is the existing glossary literal, whose canonical English source remains unestablished.

rows.en: But that will take time to complete...
No matter. Let us have Getter Robo and its allies work as hard as they can for us.
rows.notes: Getter Robo and its allies is the contemptuous collective;230 explains Burai means letting them remove rival obstacles.

rows.en: Then we shall have them eliminate those who stand in our way.
Meanwhile, we shall build up our strength in this fortress... and launch an all-out offensive when the time comes.
Yes, Your Majesty!
rows.notes: Formal assent to sovereign, not laughter.

rows.en: However, choose the right moments to keep those humans in check and gather energy. Is that clear?
rows.notes: Keep humans in check renders military restraint/harassment; the timing restriction applies to both that action and energy collection.

rows.en: Hyakki, Buraaaaai!
rows.notes: Salute/catchcry, not attack; one extra source long vowel rendered with extra a beyond campaign term baseline.
uncertain: Hyakki salute has source-backed phonetic project rendering; independently canonical English cry remains unestablished.

context_review.note: Reviewed all 148 reused rows: 143 generic defeat rows match reviewed Stage 11 exactly, and five special rows checked in every original numeric-use window. Read full fresh English and eleven fresh uncertainty flags against original context, retaining phonetic Hyakki/hiccups, unresolved canonical provenance and the sisters paired-robot fragment. Source-short Yousaiki and Getter Ray amplifier verified; all 235 fresh rows fit without compression.
